fact: A project by Enabel's contractors digitised the census and collection of market and moto-taxi parking taxes in Mamou commune, with collection starting in June 2026 and market revenue multiplied by four; a capitalisation workshop on 16 July 2026 looked at replication in other local governments.
title: Projet REVIS : la digitalisation au service des ressources locales à Mamou, en Guinée
